answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents lock assets into a root vault and register identity nodes along a network vine. Minting subsequent peer identities requires verifiable stake burning on a convex curve. By anchoring each identity summit atop an economic knoll where burned collateral scales superlinearly as O(N^2), the marginal cost for an attacker creating N fake agents explodes, imposing deterministic friction that bankrupts coordinated Sybils.
